caption: The drawing shows a single, clear bottle depicted with black ink lines on a beige or off-white background. The bottle is upright and cylindrical, gradually tapering inward as it moves upward before flaring out slightly at the neck and lip. There is no liquid inside the bottle. Decorative elements are present on the bottle: on the right side, there is a vertical, wavy ornamental pattern resembling stylized leaves or vines; on the left side, a partial circular shape with a geometric band and some detailing occupies a section of the bottle’s surface. The rest of the image is unmarked, with ample blank space surrounding the centrally-located bottle.
title: Liquor Flask
